groupBy: CASE WHEN policy.policyId IS NOT NULL THEN '政策法规' WHEN indicatorValue.valueId IS NOT NULL THEN '农业经济' WHEN yearbook.recordId IS NOT NULL THEN '行业年鉴' WHEN intel.intelId IS NOT NULL THEN '全球农业情报' ELSE '知识关系' END

referenceSql.sql:
WITH resource AS (
  SELECT '政策法规' AS knowledge_type, policyId AS resource_id, policyTitle AS title, reviewStatus AS status, updatedAt FROM Policy
  UNION ALL SELECT '农业经济', valueId, indicatorId, status, updatedAt FROM IvdData
  UNION ALL SELECT '行业年鉴', recordId, yearbookName, status, updatedAt FROM YrbYearbook
  UNION ALL SELECT '全球农业情报', intelId, intelTitle, status, updatedAt FROM Intel
  UNION ALL SELECT '知识关系', relationId, predicate, status, updatedAt FROM Relation
)
SELECT knowledge_type AS knowledgeType, COUNT(resource_id) AS itemCount,
       SUM(CASE WHEN status = '已发布' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS publishedCount,
       SUM(CASE WHEN status = '待审核' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingCount,
       MAX(updatedAt) AS latestUpdatedAt
FROM resource
WHERE (:knowledgeType IS NULL OR knowledge_type = :knowledgeType)
  AND (:status IS NULL OR status = :status)
  AND (:dateFrom IS NULL OR updatedAt >= :dateFrom)
  AND (:dateTo IS NULL OR updatedAt <= :dateTo)
  AND (:keyword IS NULL OR title LIKE '%' || :keyword || '%')
GROUP BY knowledge_type
ORDER BY itemCount DESC, knowledge_type ASC

query_reports.name: 指标时序对比
query_reports.description: 按指标、地区、品种与期间输出已发布指标值；同比仅在同指标、同地区、同品种、同期间类型且上年同期存在时计算，否则为空

joins.conditionExpression: previousYear.indicatorId == value.indicatorId AND previousYear.regionId == value.regionId AND COALESCE(previousYear.commodityId, '') == COALESCE(value.commodityId, '') AND previousYear.periodType == value.periodType AND previousYear.period == CAST(CAST(SUBSTR(value.period, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - 1 AS TEXT) || SUBSTR(value.period, 5) AND previousYear.status == '已发布'

referenceSql.sql:
SELECT i.indicatorName, r.regionName, c.commodityName, v.period, v.value, v.unit,
       CASE WHEN py.value IS NULL OR py.value = 0 THEN NULL ELSE v.value / py.value - 1 END AS yoyRate,
       d.title AS sourceTitle, v.segmentId
FROM IvdData v
JOIN Indicator i ON v.indicatorId = i.indicatorId
JOIN Region r ON v.regionId = r.regionId
LEFT JOIN CmdCommodity c ON v.commodityId = c.commodityId
JOIN SourceDoc d ON v.sourceDocId = d.docId
LEFT JOIN IvdData py ON py.indicatorId = v.indicatorId AND py.regionId = v.regionId
  AND COALESCE(py.commodityId, '') = COALESCE(v.commodityId, '')
  AND py.periodType = v.periodType
  AND py.period = CAST(CAST(substr(v.period, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - 1 AS TEXT) || substr(v.period, 5)
  AND py.status = '已发布'
WHERE v.indicatorId = :indicatorId
  AND (:regionId IS NULL OR v.regionId = :regionId)
  AND (:commodityId IS NULL OR v.commodityId = :commodityId)
  AND (:periodFrom IS NULL OR v.period >= :periodFrom)
  AND (:periodTo IS NULL OR v.period <= :periodTo)
  AND v.status = '已发布'
ORDER BY v.period ASC, r.regionName ASC

query_reports.name: 来源可追溯抽查
query_reports.description: 从政策法规中按知识类别随机抽取条目，核对来源文档、段落页码、章节、字符区间和段落摘要

referenceSql.sql:
SELECT p.policyId, p.policyTitle, d.title AS documentTitle, s.pageNo, s.chapterPath,
       s.charStart || '-' || s.charEnd AS charRange, substr(s.segmentText, 1, 300) AS segmentSummary
FROM Policy p
JOIN SourceDoc d ON p.sourceDocId = d.docId
JOIN SourceDoc_Segment s ON p.sourceDocId = s.docId AND p.segmentId = s.segmentId
JOIN KtcCategory k ON p.knowledgeCategoryId = k.categoryId
WHERE (:rootCategory IS NULL OR k.rootCategory = :rootCategory) AND p.reviewStatus = '已发布'
ORDER BY RANDOM() LIMIT :sampleSize

query_reports.name: 质量治理看板
query_reports.description: 按问题类型统计待处理、已融合与冲突问题数量及平均相似度，支持按处理状态和时间过滤明细范围

resultColumns.name: pendingCount
resultColumns.label: 待处理数
resultColumns.sourceExpression: CASE WHEN quality.handleStatus = '待处理' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

resultColumns.name: mergedCount
resultColumns.label: 已融合数
resultColumns.sourceExpression: CASE WHEN quality.handleStatus = '已融合' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

resultColumns.name: conflictCount
resultColumns.label: 冲突数
resultColumns.sourceExpression: CASE WHEN quality.issueType = '属性冲突' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

referenceSql.sql:
SELECT issueType,
       SUM(CASE WHEN handleStatus = '待处理' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingCount,
       SUM(CASE WHEN handleStatus = '已融合' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mergedCount,
       SUM(CASE WHEN issueType = '属性冲突' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS conflictCount,
       AVG(similarity) AS averageSimilarity
FROM QisRecord
WHERE (:issueType IS NULL OR issueType = :issueType)
  AND (:handleStatus IS NULL OR handleStatus = :handleStatus)
  AND (:handledFrom IS NULL OR handledAt >= :handledFrom)
  AND (:handledTo IS NULL OR handledAt <= :handledTo)
GROUP BY issueType ORDER BY pendingCount DESC

query_reports.name: 本体概念覆盖统计
query_reports.description: 按本体来源与概念类型统计概念数、同义词数、已发布关系数和按已发布关系数加权的平均置信度

columns.name: relationCount
columns.sourceExpression: CASE WHEN status = '已发布' THEN relationId ELSE NULL END

columns.name: confidenceSum
columns.sourceExpression: CASE WHEN status = '已发布' THEN confidence ELSE 0 END

columns.name: relationCount
columns.sourceExpression: CASE WHEN status = '已发布' THEN relationId ELSE NULL END

columns.name: confidenceSum
columns.sourceExpression: CASE WHEN status = '已发布' THEN confidence ELSE 0 END

joins.conditionExpression: concept.conceptId == subjectRelation.subjectEntityId AND subjectRelation.subjectEntityType == '本体概念'
concept.conceptId == objectRelation.objectEntityId AND objectRelation.objectEntityType == '本体概念'

referenceSql.sql:
WITH synonym_agg AS (
  SELECT conceptId, COUNT(synonymId) AS synonymCount FROM Concept_Synonym GROUP BY conceptId
), subject_relation AS (
  SELECT subjectEntityType, subjectEntityId,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = '已发布' THEN relationId END) AS relationCount,
         SUM(CASE WHEN status = '已发布' THEN confidence ELSE 0 END) AS confidenceSum
  FROM Relation GROUP BY subjectEntityType, subjectEntityId
), object_relation AS (
  SELECT objectEntityType, objectEntityId,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = '已发布' THEN relationId END) AS relationCount,
         SUM(CASE WHEN status = '已发布' THEN confidence ELSE 0 END) AS confidenceSum
  FROM Relation GROUP BY objectEntityType, objectEntityId
)
SELECT c.sourceOntology, c.conceptType, COUNT(DISTINCT c.conceptId) AS conceptCount,
       COALESCE(SUM(cs.synonymCount), 0) AS synonymCount,
       SUM(COALESCE(sr.relationCount, 0) + COALESCE(orr.relationCount, 0)) AS relationCount,
       SUM(COALESCE(sr.confidenceSum, 0) + COALESCE(orr.confidenceSum, 0)) /
         NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(sr.relationCount, 0) + COALESCE(orr.relationCount, 0)), 0) AS averageConfidence
FROM Concept c
LEFT JOIN synonym_agg cs ON c.conceptId = cs.conceptId
LEFT JOIN subject_relation sr ON c.conceptId = sr.subjectEntityId AND sr.subjectEntityType = '本体概念'
LEFT JOIN object_relation orr ON c.conceptId = orr.objectEntityId AND orr.objectEntityType = '本体概念'
WHERE (:sourceOntology IS NULL OR c.sourceOntology = :sourceOntology)
  AND (:conceptType IS NULL OR c.conceptType = :conceptType)
GROUP BY c.sourceOntology, c.conceptType ORDER BY conceptCount DESC

query_reports.name: 采集运行监控
query_reports.description: 按采集源统计最近执行时间、成功失败次数、新增文档数、去重跳过数与平均耗时

resultColumns.name: successCount
resultColumns.label: 成功次数
resultColumns.sourceExpression: CASE WHEN run.runStatus = '成功' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

resultColumns.name: failureCount
resultColumns.label: 失败次数
resultColumns.sourceExpression: CASE WHEN run.runStatus = '失败' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

referenceSql.sql:
SELECT c.sourceName, MAX(r.startedAt) AS lastRunAt,
       SUM(CASE WHEN r.runStatus = '成功' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successCount,
       SUM(CASE WHEN r.runStatus = '失败' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failureCount,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.newDocCount), 0) AS newDocumentCount,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.duplicateCount), 0) AS duplicateSkipCount,
       AVG(r.durationMs) AS averageDurationMs
FROM CrsSource c LEFT JOIN CrsSource_CrawlRun r ON c.crawlSourceId = r.crawlSourceId
WHERE (:crawlSourceId IS NULL OR c.crawlSourceId = :crawlSourceId)
  AND (:runStatus IS NULL OR r.runStatus = :runStatus)
  AND (:startedFrom IS NULL OR r.startedAt >= :startedFrom)
  AND (:startedTo IS NULL OR r.startedAt <= :startedTo)
GROUP BY c.crawlSourceId, c.sourceName ORDER BY lastRunAt DESC

query_reports.name: 知识体系覆盖与缺口
query_reports.description: 按分类节点统计四类知识条目的直接与含子类数量、已发布数量及空白节点标识；四类条目按 UNION 语义合并，递归分类闭包由参考 SQL 实现，时间范围按条目更新时间过滤

joins.conditionExpression: descendantCategory.categoryPath == category.categoryPath OR descendantCategory.categoryPath LIKE category.categoryPath + '/%'

conditions.leftExpression: CASE WHEN policy.policyId IS NOT NULL THEN policy.updatedAt WHEN indicatorValue.valueId IS NOT NULL THEN indicatorValue.updatedAt WHEN yearbook.recordId IS NOT NULL THEN yearbook.updatedAt ELSE intel.updatedAt END

CASE WHEN policy.policyId IS NOT NULL THEN policy.updatedAt WHEN indicatorValue.valueId IS NOT NULL THEN indicatorValue.updatedAt WHEN yearbook.recordId IS NOT NULL THEN yearbook.updatedAt ELSE intel.updatedAt END

resultColumns.name: directItemCount
resultColumns.label: 直接条目数
resultColumns.sourceExpression: CASE WHEN descendantCategory.categoryId = category.categoryId THEN CASE WHEN policy.policyId IS NOT NULL THEN policy.policyId WHEN indicatorValue.valueId IS NOT NULL THEN indicatorValue.valueId WHEN yearbook.recordId IS NOT NULL THEN yearbook.recordId ELSE intel.intelId END ELSE NULL END

resultColumns.name: descendantItemCount
resultColumns.label: 含子类条目数
resultColumns.sourceExpression: CASE WHEN policy.policyId IS NOT NULL THEN policy.policyId WHEN indicatorValue.valueId IS NOT NULL THEN indicatorValue.valueId WHEN yearbook.recordId IS NOT NULL THEN yearbook.recordId ELSE intel.intelId END

resultColumns.name: publishedCount
resultColumns.label: 已发布数
resultColumns.sourceExpression: CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN policy.policyId IS NOT NULL THEN policy.reviewStatus WHEN indicatorValue.valueId IS NOT NULL THEN indicatorValue.status WHEN yearbook.recordId IS NOT NULL THEN yearbook.status ELSE intel.status END) = '已发布' THEN CASE WHEN policy.policyId IS NOT NULL THEN policy.policyId WHEN indicatorValue.valueId IS NOT NULL THEN indicatorValue.valueId WHEN yearbook.recordId IS NOT NULL THEN yearbook.recordId ELSE intel.intelId END ELSE NULL END

resultColumns.name: emptyNodeFlag
resultColumns.label: 空白节点标识
resultColumns.sourceExpression: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN policy.policyId IS NOT NULL THEN policy.policyId WHEN indicatorValue.valueId IS NOT NULL THEN indicatorValue.valueId WHEN yearbook.recordId IS NOT NULL THEN yearbook.recordId ELSE intel.intelId END) = 0

referenceSql.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE category_tree(categoryId, descendantId) AS (
  SELECT categoryId, categoryId FROM KtcCategory
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ct.categoryId, c.categoryId FROM category_tree ct JOIN KtcCategory c ON c.parentCategoryId = ct.descendantId
), entry AS (
  SELECT knowledgeCategoryId, 'POL:' || policyId AS resourceId, reviewStatus AS status, updatedAt FROM Policy
  UNION ALL SELECT knowledgeCategoryId, 'IVD:' || valueId, status, updatedAt FROM IvdData
  UNION ALL SELECT knowledgeCategoryId, 'YRB:' || recordId, status, updatedAt FROM YrbYearbook
  UNION ALL SELECT knowledgeCategoryId, 'INT:' || intelId, status, updatedAt FROM Intel
), coverage AS (
  SELECT ct.categoryId, e.resourceId, e.status, e.updatedAt,
         CASE WHEN ct.categoryId = ct.descendantId THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isDirect
  FROM category_tree ct JOIN entry e ON e.knowledgeCategoryId = ct.descendantId
  WHERE (:dateFrom IS NULL OR e.updatedAt >= :dateFrom) AND (:dateTo IS NULL OR e.updatedAt <= :dateTo)
)
SELECT k.categoryCode, k.categoryPath,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.isDirect = 1 THEN c.resourceId END) AS directItemCount,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.resourceId) AS descendantItemCount,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.status = '已发布' THEN c.resourceId END) AS publishedCount,
       CASE WHEN COUNT(c.resourceId) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS emptyNodeFlag
FROM KtcCategory k LEFT JOIN coverage c ON k.categoryId = c.categoryId
WHERE (:rootCategory IS NULL OR k.rootCategory = :rootCategory) AND (:level IS NULL OR k.level = :level)
GROUP BY k.categoryId, k.categoryCode, k.categoryPath ORDER BY k.categoryPath ASC
